subject: PII handling for prompts/outputs - confirmation & next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PII handling for prompts/outputs - follow-up from discovery call

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for your time on today's call. Per our discussion, I'm summarizing the key points and next steps around PII/data handling for prompts and model outputs:

- Current ask: confirm what parts of prompts/outputs (if any) Acme needs Redwood to store for diagnostics, troubleshooting, or future model improvements.
- Retention: Acme preference mentioned: short-term storage only; need to confirm exact retention window (you mentioned ~90 days as a possibility).
- Residency: Acme needs data to remain in US-only regions (US-East preferred).
- Logging controls: minimize logged content; prefer token-level billing logs only; no full-output archiving unless explicitly allowed.
- Attestations: you requested SOC 2 Type II and confirmation of encryption at rest and in transit.

Attached is a short summary (redwood-pii-handling-summary.pdf) that outlines our defaults and configurable options. Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the retention window you'd like for prompts/outputs (e.g., 0/30/90 days)?
2) Would you like Redwood to disable prompt/output retention entirely for your account (we support an opt-out for hosted customers) or are you planning on Dedicated/Private deployment?
3) Are there any legal/procurement prerequisites (NDA, DPA) we should start in parallel?

I'll loop in Neha from our security team to provide the technical confirmation once you confirm the retention/residency choices.
\Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
\Attachment: redwood-pii-handling-summary.pdf (summary of defaults & config options)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jim Owens <jim.owens@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PII handling for prompts/outputs - follow-up from discovery call

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Retention: We would prefer no long-term storage of prompts/outputs. Ideally 0 days for full-output storage. If that is not possible for hosted accounts, 90 days is the absolute maximum.
- Residency: Yes, data must remain in US only (US-East region preferred).
- Logging: We can accept token-level aggregated billing logs for cost reconciliation, but we cannot have full prompt/output archives stored. Any diagnostic logs that include redacted outputs are acceptable with strict access controls.
- Attestations: Please send SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation of encryption at rest using customer-managed KMS options if available.

We've attached our internal requirements spreadsheet for your security team (acme-data-requirements.xlsx). Once Neha confirms the available configuration for hosted versus Dedicated/Private, let's schedule a technical call the week of Mar 12.
\Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Head of Data Governance | Acme Health
sarah.lee@acmehealth.com
\Attachment: acme-data-requirements.xlsx

\—Rishi

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PII handling for prompts/outputs - confirmation & next steps

Hi Sarah,
\Thanks for the clear requirements and the spreadsheet — useful details. Quick technical confirmation from Redwood's side:
\- Hosted API (Redwood cloud):
  - Default diagnostic retention: 30 days for request/response logs used for debugging and abuse detection. These are redacted by default for common PII patterns but can still contain residual non-PII text.
  - Opt-out: We can disable prompt/output retention at the account level (0-day retention) for hosted customers on enterprise plans. This disables storage of full prompt/response payloads; short-lived telemetry for system health may still be retained in aggregated form.
  - Residency: We can restrict storage and processing to US-East for the account with our enterprise hosting policy.
  - KMS: Hosted accounts can be configured to use customer-managed keys for encryption-at-rest via our KMS integration (AWS KMS). Key lifecycle and access policies are controlled by the customer.

- Dedicated/Private deployment:
  - Offers full control: you can choose zero retention and keep all logs on-prem or in your VPC. This is the recommended path if your policies mandate zero storage and fully customer-controlled keys.

- Billing/logging:
  - Token-level billing data (aggregated usage metrics) is retained for 90 days for invoicing and cost analytics; this does not contain full prompt/outputs.

- Attestations & docs:
  - Attached: SOC2-report-2026.pdf.
  - Docs: https://drive.google.com/redwood/policy/pii-handling (detailed config options) and our standard DPA/NDA templates we can start populating.

Next steps:
1) If Acme wants 0-day retention on hosted, we can enable that flag — please confirm engagement owner and account contact to make the change.
2) Proposed technical call: Thu Mar 12, 10:00 AM ET / 7:00 AM PT — Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood/security-call-30m
3) We'll prepare a short runbook showing how logs are redacted, how KMS encryption is set up, and the opt-out steps.
\Happy to hop on a call to walk through the options.
\Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
\Attachments: SOC2-report-2026.pdf
